summary: Camera 312 at the Pyrmont Bridge Rd ramp to Anzac Bridge covers four zones; it was dead for 11 weeks (2024-06-13 to 2024-08-29) and its first morning, both set missing. Zone 430 (west path south of the crossing, ~10 bikes/day) had phantom detections of thousands of bikes on 2025-12-20 and 2025-12-27..31, set missing, with smaller unexplained bursts marked uncertain. The feed drops zero slots for zones 430 and 431, so they are zero-filled; the 2026-07-28 level step at 430/429 is kept as a real change.
